nodes.name: accessibility.md
nodes.summary: Accessibility guidelines covering keyboard navigation, focus management, labels, semantic structure, contrast ratios, screen reader support, and validation feedback for the Persuratan application.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown documentation file with no code.

nodes.name: component-guidelines.md
nodes.summary: Component development guidelines defining reuse-first philosophy, naming conventions (Primitive/Pattern/Feature/Page), single-responsibility principle, composition over inheritance, variant patterns via props, required interactive states, and file organization structure.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown documentation with Vue code examples.

nodes.name: design-system.md
nodes.summary: Core design system defining the 'Professional Workspace' design language with foundations: color tokens (primary, semantic), surface system, typography scale, 4px spacing grid, border radius tokens, elevation levels, component library layering (Nuxt UI → Tokens → App → Feature), and Lucide icon system.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown documentation defining token naming conventions and visual foundations.

nodes.name: interaction-patterns.md
nodes.summary: Eight UI interaction patterns: workspace navigation (sidebar/resource/canvas), builder canvas (left/center/right panels), command palette (Cmd+K), form submission with validation, destructive action confirmation, drag and drop, split view (editor + preview), and step wizard with progress indicator.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown documentation with ASCII interaction flow diagrams.

nodes.name: responsive.md
nodes.summary: Responsive design strategy defining breakpoints (sm/md/lg/xl/2xl), desktop workspace layout (sidebar+canvas+properties), tablet collapsible sidebar, mobile single-column with bottom navigation, plus responsive tables, forms, and navigation behavior across breakpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown documentation with breakpoint definitions and layout specifications.

nodes.name: ui-principles.md
nodes.summary: UI design principles covering visual hierarchy (title→context→action→content→secondary), consistency via design tokens, density for power users, clarity with one primary action per section, information architecture with tabs/breadcrumbs/sidebar, and the workspace concept (sidebar+canvas+properties).
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown documentation with ASCII workspace layout diagram.

nodes.name: ux-principles.md
nodes.summary: UX principles covering discoverability (visible actions, command palette, empty states), feedback for every action (toasts, dialogs, spinners), error prevention (validate before save, destructive warnings), progressive disclosure, predictable interaction (click/hover/drag conventions), and user efficiency (shortcuts, inline editing, bulk ops).
